_description: H4: Momentum reweight - shift scoring from proximity 0.60 + momentum 0.40 to proximity 0.45 + momentum 0.55. Tests whether favoring momentum over proximity in candidate ranking improves trade quality. Built on baseline_v5 (H1 integrated).
_hypothesis: H4 from 16-agent analysis: strong gains came from high-momentum names (NVDA, SMCI, VRT, APP) but win rate was only 45.9%. Proximity dominates current scoring but momentum may be under-weighted. Shifting to 0.45/0.55 should surface higher-momentum candidates first.
_baseline: Compare to h1_floor_jan_mar and h1_floor_jul_sep. Delta = H4 momentum reweight effect only.
_code_change: Requires score_weight_proximity + score_weight_momentum params added to WeeklyStockRotator (wired in run_backtest.py). Defaults preserved at 0.60/0.40 so existing runs unaffected.
